title: Quantum Injection Pathways for Implicit Graph Neural Networks
summary: Deep Equilibrium Models (DEQs) replace a stack of explicit layers with a single operator whose fixed point defines the output, giving the expressive power of an arbitrarily deep network at the memory cost of a single layer. Quantum Deep Equilibrium Models (QDEQs) bring this idea to quantum machine learning, offering an alternative to Parameterized Quantum Circuits (PQCs), whose depth is limited by hardware coherence and trainability. Here, we introduce, formulate, and compare three ways of coupling a quantum signal to graph DEQs, differing in where the signal enters the fixed-point operator.…
